name: Tarkop Profit Manager for WooCommerce
author: tarkop

sections.description:
Plugin page: https://tarkop.dev/tarkop-profit-manager-for-woocommerce/

Tarkop Profit Manager for WooCommerce adds cost prices to simple products and variations, records historical cost snapshots for new orders, and turns that data into clear gross-profit reports.

Free includes:

  • Cost price for simple products and individual variations.
  • Historical cost snapshots stored in hidden WooCommerce order metadata.
  • Revenue, COGS, gross profit and margin in orders.
  • Partial and full refund-aware revenue, COGS, profit and product reports.
  • Cost, profit and margin columns in the product list.
  • Profit Dashboard with date ranges.
  • Product Profit report.
  • WooCommerce built-in product CSV import/export support for Cost price.
  • HPOS compatibility using WooCommerce CRUD APIs.
  • Cart and Checkout Blocks compatibility.
  • Theme-independent admin interface that does not inject frontend markup into themes or Elementor layouts.
  • Bundled translations for 74 WordPress locales, plus translation-ready strings and an RTL-safe admin layout.

Historical accuracy matters: old orders that do not contain a cost snapshot are clearly marked and excluded from aggregate profit totals instead of being silently recalculated using today’s product cost.

Languages

English is the source language. Bundled translations are included for 74 WordPress locales:

  • Arabic (ar), Azerbaijani (az), Belarusian (be_BY), Bulgarian (bg_BG), Bengali (bn_BD), Bosnian (bs_BA), Catalan (ca), Czech (cs_CZ), Welsh (cy), Danish (da_DK).
  • German: Austria (de_AT), Switzerland (de_CH), Germany (de_DE); Greek (el); Spanish: Argentina (es_AR), Chile (es_CL), Colombia (es_CO), Spain (es_ES), Mexico (es_MX), Peru (es_PE), Venezuela (es_VE).
  • Estonian (et), Basque (eu), Persian (fa_IR), Finnish (fi), Faroese (fo); French: Belgium (fr_BE), Canada (fr_CA), Switzerland (fr_CH), France (fr_FR).
  • Irish (ga), Scottish Gaelic (gd), Galician (gl_ES), Hebrew (he_IL), Hindi (hi_IN), Croatian (hr), Hungarian (hu_HU), Armenian (hy), Indonesian (id_ID), Icelandic (is_IS).
  • Italian: Switzerland (it_CH), Italy (it_IT); Japanese (ja), Georgian (ka_GE), Korean (ko_KR), Luxembourgish (lb_LU), Lithuanian (lt_LT), Latvian (lv), Macedonian (mk_MK), Malay (ms_MY), Maltese (mt_MT).
  • Norwegian Bokmål (nb_NO); Dutch: Belgium (nl_BE), Netherlands (nl_NL); Polish (pl_PL); Portuguese: Angola (pt_AO), Brazil (pt_BR), Portugal (pt_PT); Romansh (rm), Romanian (ro_RO), Russian (ru_RU).
  • Slovak (sk_SK), Slovenian (sl_SI), Albanian (sq), Serbian Cyrillic (sr_RS), Serbian Latin (sr_RS_latin), Swedish (sv_SE), Thai (th), Turkish (tr_TR), Ukrainian (uk), Vietnamese (vi).
  • Chinese: Simplified (zh_CN), Hong Kong (zh_HK), Traditional (zh_TW).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP in Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is active.
  4. Add Cost price values to products and variations.
  5. Open WooCommerce > Profit Manager.
sections.faq:
Does it work with HPOS?

Yes. Order data is read and written through WooCommerce order and order-item objects, and the plugin declares HPOS compatibility.

Does it work with Elementor and popular themes?

The plugin’s profit interface is in WordPress/WooCommerce admin and does not alter frontend theme templates, so it is independent of Elementor and normal storefront themes.

What happens to old orders?

The plugin never pretends that today’s cost was the historical cost. Orders without historical snapshots are clearly marked and excluded from aggregate profit totals.

What does Revenue mean in the free version?

Product line revenue after product discounts, excluding tax and shipping. Gross profit is Revenue minus historical COGS.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Restored compatibility with historical cost data stored by earlier plugin builds under legacy meta keys.
  • Preserved the original historical item cost when legacy and current snapshot keys overlap.
  • Made Dashboard and Product Profit exclude incomplete historical orders consistently.
  • Aligned the live product profit estimate with the tax-exclusive calculation used by PHP reports.
  • Stopped order-item edits from backfilling missing historical costs with today’s product cost.
  • Hardened partial and full refund handling, including unallocated fee, shipping and tax refunds.

1.0.2

  • Added the official plugin website URL to the plugin metadata.
  • Updated release metadata for version 1.0.2.

1.0.1

  • Fixed custom date range selection on the Profit Dashboard and Product Profit report.
  • Restored the review/support card on the plugin dashboard with direct links to WordPress.org reviews and the support forum.
  • Added the bundled translation language list to readme.txt.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Product and variation cost prices.
  • Live Estimated profit and Estimated margin beside cost fields for simple products and variations.
  • Localized help tooltips for cost and estimate fields.
  • Historical order-level cost snapshots.
  • Order and product profit/margin columns.
  • Partial/full refund recalculation with refunded quantities reflected in COGS.
  • Profit Dashboard and Product Profit report.
  • WooCommerce CSV import/export integration.
  • HPOS and Checkout Blocks compatibility.
  • WordPress.org Plugin Check fixes for translator comments and sanitized/unslashed product cost input.
